title: TesterArmy: About us
text:
TesterArmy is built by Szymon Rybczak and Oskar Kwaśniewski. Our mission: AI-powered QA testing that lets teams ship faster and break nothing.

about
The team behind TesterArmy
We’re two engineers who got tired of QA being the slowest part of shipping. So we built an army of AI testers that never sleeps.
Our mission
Every team wants to ship fast. Nobody wants to break production. Traditional QA forces you to pick one: manual testing is slow, and test scripts rot the moment your UI changes.
TesterArmy replaces brittle scripts with AI agents that test your web and mobile apps the way real users do - clicking, typing, and verifying flows in plain language. Our mission is simple: make world-class QA available to every team, so you can ship faster and break nothing.
